# Seattle DGX Spark Hackathon Winners Spotlight
## Seattle DGX Spark Hackathon Winners Spotlight
Across the See, Do, and Spark tracks, teams combined vision, speech, retrieval, simulation, and agent workflows to build systems that perceive the world, take action, and run locally on GB10-powered systems. We’re sitting down with two winning teams: Kerberos, winner of the See Track, who built a shared spatial-awareness system for search-and-rescue teams that brings responders, robots, and drones into one live map — and VELA, winner of the Do Track, who built a voice-first healthcare action system that compares paths to care and requires explicit user consent before taking consequential actions.
